errors.error_description: Used an inefficient arithmetic operation that infers heavy hardware by multiplying the counter by 7 in a datapath branch, creating suboptimal area/timing.
Used case equality (===) in synthesizable control logic to compare the counter against a threshold, which is non-synthesizable and dangerous in RTL.
Included an FSM state named UNUSED in the enum that is never transitioned to, creating an unreachable state in the state machine.
Created an unintended latch by assigning status_d only when enable is true without providing an else/default assignment in a combinational block.
